style: Use case: illustration-story / scientific-educational. ONE children's science picture book illustration, landscape aspect 1216:832. Warm watercolor and colored pencils on fine cream paper, friendly refined rounded shapes, clear educational detail and believable construction, age 4-8. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks or panel borders. Leave important objects comfortably inside margins. No baked-in arrows; all labels and arrows are added separately by the website.
scenes: Cover: realistic friendly orbital space station, silver cylindrical modules joined in T arrangement, blue rectangular solar wings, articulated pale robot arm folded on exterior. Curved blue Earth and white clouds below, navy space above. Three-quarter wide view all solar wings inside image; no flags, logos or imaginary buildings.

Cutaway scene of orbital station: rounded silver habitation module attached to blue solar panels exterior, part of side hull removed to reveal astronaut in blue clothes gently floating INSIDE the pressurized module. Earth far below. Make clear a house in space is engineering modules, not a cottage; no unsuited astronaut outside.

Close overview of T-shaped station's three cylindrical modules joined by round connectors, pair of broad blue solar wings above and below left, long articulated white robot arm anchored to right module. Silver thermal insulation, visible connecting joints. Space and Earth's edge; three parts distinct.

Habitation module interior with warm work lights and round hatch rear. Left wall upright attached blue sleeping bag with astronaut tucked in, center small table with food packets held by straps and velcro, right exercise treadmill with astronaut secured by elastic harness to deck. Slight microgravity floating hair, no furniture floating free, wide cross-sectional room composition.

Space laboratory interior: green lettuce plants rooted in sealed growth tray left under purple growing light, transparent secured crystal growth chamber center showing faceted crystals, organized experiment rack of equipment and switches right. Astronaut checks experiment quietly behind, no impossible open floating soil or open boiling liquid.

Close external view large blue grid solar panel angled to catch bright sunlight from upper-left, silver station module behind at right, curved blue Earth lower corner. Light naturally illuminates cells, no baked arrows or drawn rays crossing panel, no text.

Robot arm operation closeup in orbit: long articulated white arm with visible elbow joints anchored securely to station at left, small circular end effector grasping standard grapple pin atop arriving silver cargo spacecraft at right. Show continuous arm connection and actual grasp, blue Earth below. No human hand as robot arm.

Docking closeup: silver visiting spacecraft at left aligned nose-to-nose with circular docking collar on station right. Matching round rings face one another with small final gap, consistent central axes. Blue solar wings in background, black space and Earth far below. No collision, no flame between ports.

Orbital concept base art: large blue-green Earth globe slightly left of center, small accurate silver station with blue solar wings in open upper-right space. Leave broad space around globe for SVG elliptical orbital path; NO baked orbit or arrows. Clearly separate station and Earth, not station on Earth's surface.

Inside station floating scene: smiling adult astronaut wearing blue work shirt and trousers suspended diagonally in middle of cabin without feet touching floor, one bright yellow pencil floating separately on left with no writing. Secured sleeping bag on rear wall and round hatch, tiny loose water globule okay, no open door to space.

Life support equipment cutaway INSIDE station: left oxygen generator rack with sealed metal tanks and tubing, right water recycling unit with closed blue water tank, filtration cylinders and connected pipes. Astronaut drinks from sealed pouch using straw in background. No free bubbles in cabin, no uncontained dirty water; leave clear hotpot targets on two machines.

View from INSIDE cupola: curved metal window frame around edges, vast blue Earth white swirling clouds fills center and bottom, green auroral ribbon hugs planet's upper atmospheric edge. No aurora floating beside station in vacuum. Warm interior silhouettes bottom only, dark space above horizon.

Return journey begins in orbit: small compact conical crew capsule connected to a short cylindrical service module departing to lower-left, station stays distant upper-right, Earth's blue curved atmosphere below. No parachute in space, no blazing reentry while still touching station, no astronaut outside.

Recap spacious composition: large station silver modules and blue solar wings center-left, astronaut in properly sealed white EVA suit and tether to station at right, Earth's curve beneath. Solar wings clear on station, no duplicated free-floating human limbs, no text or diagram labels.
